# GRANTLUX

GRANTLUX designs and manufactures custom kitchens and cabinet furniture in Ulyanovsk and the Ulyanovsk region.

## Services

- Custom kitchen design and production
- Kitchen cost calculation
- Facade, countertop and fittings selection
- Delivery and installation
- Measurement and project discussion

## Location

- City: Ulyanovsk
- Region: Ulyanovsk region, Russia
- Address: 2-й Инженерный проезд, 2А
- Phone: +7 927 633-21-97
- Hours: daily from 10:00 to 20:00
